title: Aerated Chicken Tacos
description: A flavorful Mexican dish with crispy tacos and a moist interior, topped with fresh cilantro and a dollop of sour cream.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix to coat.
Add the cubed bread to the marinade and mix to coat.
Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, toast the bread in the skillet until crispy and golden brown.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve the chicken in tacos with toasted bread, cilantro, and a dollop of sour cream.
